goal: Implement BIP 54 consensus cleanup rules to prepare and test fixes for known consensus vulnerabilities
Addresses quadratic sigop CPU exhaustion, 64-byte tx collisions, and timewarp retarget attacks
Enables validation on regtest while keeping the rules inactive on production networks
reviewability: Review is worthwhile now with no blockers or invalidating issues
agreement: Strong support with mutation testing verifying rule enforcement (instagibbs, ismaelsadeeq, ViniciusCestarii)
Verified test vectors against the BIP specification and tested counting via btclib (fametrano)
Broad code review and approval across the consensus changes (optout21, theStack, nervana21)
Open questions on cache reorg edge cases and compact block coinbase validation (ariard)

categories.name: validation
why: P2 because it prepares fixes for severe consensus flaws like CPU exhaustion and timewarp retargeting
Immediate production impact is deferred since activation is strictly confined to regtest
